normalization: official quantile normalize/unnormalize, eight physical dimensions; tokenize before padding
gripper_conversion: piecewise inverse of actual r_close/l_close actuator travel plus proportional feedback on measured closure; not 2*closure-1
action_semantics: DROID seven normalized joint commands and gripper closure [0,1]; divide seven commands by max(1,infinity norm), multiply by 0.2 rad/tick and 15 Hz before Sawyer projection; ordered joints are not a verified cross-robot correspondence
kinematic_conversion: Sawyer TCP Jacobian times orientation-nullspace-projected joint velocity times actual env.dt; divide by env.action_scale; gripper from eighth action dimension
image_rotation: 180 degrees; unchanged from previous run and RLinf reference
success_rule: first info.success=true immediately ends the episode and counts success
limitation: Physical bridge is testable, but DROID Franka normalization/joint semantics are only a surrogate for Sawyer; no native Sawyer pretraining asset is present. No claim of native action-space compatibility.

prompts.disassemble-v2: Pick a nut out of a peg
